name: Terra The Magic Place
dinnerNote: Typical spend without drinks (Gambero Rosso average)
dinnerNoteIt: Spesa media bevande escluse (media Gambero Rosso)

stay.name: Terra - The Magic Place

packages.name: Short stay & Gourmet Experience
packages.includes: A night’s stay, the 10-course TERRA EXPERIENCE tasting menu in the two-star restaurant, gourmet breakfast, welcome drink and afternoon spa and jacuzzi access

packages.name: 2-nights Romantic Getaway
packages.includes: Two nights, two dinners in the two-star restaurant (one 5-course menu, one TERRA EXPERIENCE menu), breakfast, welcome drink and afternoon spa and jacuzzi access

packages.name: Mid-week special
packages.includes: Three nights, all dinners in the two-star restaurant (two 5-course menus, one TERRA EXPERIENCE menu), gourmet breakfast, welcome drink and free hiking poles and backpacks
packages.when: Tuesday to Friday; not 15 July to 15 September or 25 December to 8 January

packages.name: 4 Nights Wine & Dine
packages.includes: Four nights, four dinners in the two-star restaurant with wine pairing on two evenings, breakfast, a bottle of sparkling wine on arrival and spa and jacuzzi access

stay.note: A family-run hotel of 8 rooms and 3 suites with the highest-lying two-star restaurant in Italy; stay packages include the dinners.
